messages:
eli: Kicked off post-deploy prefill smoke across canary pools. Observed oscillating prefill hit-rate in us-central1 during warmup (pulses every ~90s).
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/2026-03-25-canary -> canary pools. Postdeploy probes started (ci: 4850001111).
maya: seeing prefill hit-rate swing 92% -> 58% -> 90% across three sweeps. No 5xx, but downstream tail ops increase during low-hit windows.
sam: Any recent changes that could affect seeding or probe sampling randomness?
eli: The canary included a change to the synthetic-scheduler seed RNG seeding strategy (deterministic -> stratified-random) to improve coverage. Hypothesis: stratified sampling interacts with cache sharding and leads to hotspotting on certain prefix bands.
infra-ops: infra metrics: cache node cpu and io stable, but network egress for cache shard 5 shows spikes coincident with low-hit windows.
maya: Proposed action: hold global promote, pin us-central1 to previous model+seed strategy, and re-run synthetic sweep with controlled seed set.
sam: Agreed. Pin command:
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/route/pin -d '{"region":"us-central1","model_variant":"v2026-03-23","meta":"prefill-entropy-hold"}'
```
deploy-bot: Routing update complete for us-central1 -> v2026-03-23 (pinned). Synthetic-scheduler queued 1000 controlled seeds.
maya: Re-run with controlled seeds: hit-rate steady ~91%, no pulsation. Looks like stratified-random seed distribution amplified shard hotness.
eli: Filing RT-6402: "synthetic-scheduler: stratified seeding -> shard hot-spotting under certain prefix distributions". cc runtime@, perf@.
sam: Decision: keep us-central1 pinned for 45m, revert scheduler change for now, and add a guard in the scheduler to avoid concentrating samples on single shard ranges. Add a short blurb to release notes: 'us-central1 pinned to v2026-03-23 due to prefill hit-rate oscillation during canary; synthetic-scheduler seeding under review.'
infra-ops: We'll monitor probe and cache shard telemetry for 45m and report back.
maya: I'll attach failing seed lists and quick repro instructions to RT-6402.
sam: Thanks team. If oscillation recurs after unpin, schedule a rollback of canary tag and open a change window for deeper investigation. :thumbsup:
